brief:
Gaza conducted a mass funeral for 50 Palestinians killed in the ongoing conflict, Al Jazeera English reported. The burials took place weeks after authorities had interred 112 Palestinian bodies in another mass funeral, underscoring the relentless toll of casualties across the territory.

The successive mass burials reflect the scale of deaths in Gaza since the conflict's outbreak. Funeral ceremonies have become frequent occurrences as the casualty count continues to rise. Families gathered to mourn those killed, with the large number of dead necessitating communal burial procedures rather than individual services.
dek: Funerals take place weeks after the bodies of 112 Palestinians were buried in another mass funeral.
title: Gaza holds mass funeral for 50 Palestinians killed in war
